quote: St George Mining Limited (ASX: SGQ) (“St George” or “the Company”) is pleased to announce that it has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (“MOU”) with Nanum Nanotecnologia (“Nanum”) to create a strategic alliance whereby the parties will collaborate on the commercialisation of the cerium component in the large rare earths resource at the Company’s 100%-owned advanced, high-grade Araxá niobium-REE Project in Minas Gerais, Brazil (“Project”).
